about: Draft of 40 own-repo tasks mined from this repository's git history by `marlowe eval own-mine` (M4.6 track L). Each is a past bug fix put back: the task starts from the fix commit's parent (history dropped, so the fix cannot be read from `git log`); the fix commit's tests for one crate are hidden and run after the agent finishes. Matthew has not approved them (design 9.2-h): `needs_review` stays true and `status` stays draft until he edits statements, drops tasks and sets status to approved. All are bug fixes; the design's 15/15/5/5 split (bugfix, feature, refactor, ML) cannot come from the history, which is mostly one milestone's work.

candidates.statement:
There is a bug in the `marlowe-tui` crate of this repository: tui: review fixes for steady streaming and pixel-snapped maths.

The follow hold absorbs only a loss of up to 3 lines, and Ctrl+T bumps the epoch, so collapsing reasoning mid-reply follows the new tail rather than leaving one line over a blank pane. Scrolled up, a pane that changes height (resize, a paste that grows the composer) keeps its top line; a width change keeps the same fraction of the transcript above it. The image cache is keyed on (markup, colour, rows), not the pane width: a resize reuses every image that still fits and re-renders only one it no longer fits. The worker renders newest first and skips jobs superseded at another width. The helper 

The behaviour a regression test will check (the tests are not in the repository):
- collapsing reasoning mid stream follows the new tail
- a scrolled up view keeps its place through a paste and a resize
